description: This file contains shell functions for validating and performing firmware upgrades using the RedBoot FIS format, including image format checks and upgrade procedures with tar and mtd commands.

methods.name: platform_check_image_redboot_fis
methods.description: Checks if the provided image file has the correct magic word indicating a valid RedBoot FIS image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_redboot_fis
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade for RedBoot FIS images, extracting kernel and root filesystem from the archive and writing them to flash memory.
